specs.name: CPU
specs.value: Raspberry Pi® CM4; Quad Cortex-A72 at 1.5GHz

specs.name: Storage
specs.value: 1 x TF card slot designed for storage expansion

specs.name: USB
specs.value: 2 x USB 2.0 Host, 1 x USB TYPE-C

specs.name: Audio
specs.value: Mic input on the front panel, 2W internal stereo speaker, 3.5mm audio In/Out connector

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: Yes, High accuracy internal RTC (keep track of time one week after power off)

specs.name: RS485
specs.value: 1 x RS485, 2 Channels at most. The RS485 circuit automatically controls the Input and Output direction (no need for software control)

specs.name: Relay
specs.value: 1 x relay with “Normally Connected” and “Normally Open” output

specs.name: GPIO/Wiegand
specs.value: Two 5V Logic GPIO Outputs, can be used as Wiegand signal

specs.name: WiFi/BT
specs.value: WiFi/BT module comes with the CM4

specs.name: ZIGBEE
specs.value: Internal Zigbee supported, not mounted by default

specs.name: 4G/LTE
specs.value: Internal 4G/LTE module supported, not mounted by default
